questions.stem: A mother brings her child with features of fever, swelling and pain during movement of leg. On physical examination, signs of inflammation were present. CBC examination reveals the increased levels of neutrophils along with a microcytic anaemia. A case of osteomyelitis is suspected. On taking history, the child is found to have sickle cell disease. Which of the following organisms is responsible for osteomyelitis in this case?
